name: Genesys Works Twin Cities (training and paid internship)
what_you_do: Students finish 8 weeks of summer training in IT, business and work skills. Then they work a paid, year-long internship at a partner company. They get college and career coaching.
grades: Junior year (apply in fall or winter of junior year)
who_can_apply: Students in high school at schools that partner with Genesys Works, on track to graduate, who can work in the U.S. and can fit a lighter senior-year schedule.
pay_detail: Paid for hours worked; the site says interns can earn about $10,000 to $13,000 over the internship year. Rates vary by site.
duration: 8 weeks of summer training (160 hours), then 20 hours a week during senior year
deadline_text: No date is posted. Students apply in fall or winter of junior year and the process finishes in the spring.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Genesys Works application page. Then you interview for Summer Skills Training. Then you confirm your spot. Twin Cities contact: 651-789-0088 or tcadmin@genesysworks.org.
notes: Internships are earned. They are not promised. Students must get themselves to work. The application page named a rising senior as the target. The FAQ said junior year. The site did not agree with itself, so ask which grade to apply in. The families page gives $10,000-$12,000 for the internship year. Its summary gives $10,000-$13,000. Ask which is right.
